name: io.github.standardbeagle/errlookup
title: ErrLookup
description: Explains open-source library error messages and gives cited, ordered fixes, offline from cache.

environmentVariables.name: ERRLOOKUP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Dataset origin. Point this at a self-hosted publish of the dataset.

environmentVariables.name: ERRLOOKUP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the downloaded dataset is cached. Defaults to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/errlookup.

environmentVariables.name: ERRLOOKUP_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How often the published manifest is polled for a newer dataset version.

environmentVariables.name: ERRLOOKUP_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to serve only from the local cache and never fetch.
